sections.heading: Learning Point 1
sections.content: Recall that when some whole number of things are shared equally among some number of people, fractions tell us how much each share is.
sections.source_evidence: Recall that when some whole number of things are shared equally among some number of people, fractions tell us how much each share is.

sections.heading: Learning Point 2
sections.content: Shabnam: Do you remember, if one roti is divided equally between two children, how much roti will each child get?
sections.source_evidence: Shabnam: Do you remember, if one roti is divided equally between two children, how much roti will each child get?

sections.heading: Learning Point 4
sections.content: We also sometimes read this as ‘one upon two.’ Mukta: If one roti is equally shared among 4 children, how much roti will one child get?

sections.heading: Learning Point 17
sections.content: When one unit is divided into several equal parts, each part is called a fractional unit.
sections.source_evidence: When one unit is divided into several equal parts, each part is called a fractional unit.

sections.heading: Learning Point 18
sections.content: These are all fractional units: 1 2 , 1 3 , 1 4 , 1 5 , 1 6 , …, 1 10 , …, 1 50 , …, 1 100, etc.
